purpose: Natural-prevalence final test. Drawn from geography already held out of training, with no per-class control, so the class mix is the real distribution of that area. Scored once, after model selection, and never fitted on.

sampling.method: Uniform random draw by md5(osm_id) ordering within each held-out one-degree cell, capped per cell.
sampling.region_note: The public endpoint times out on a query that must touch every graded way worldwide, so the draw is restricted to the largest contiguous clusters of held-out cells and a bounding-box pre-filter lets the service use a spatial index. The result is a natural-prevalence sample of those regions, not a global one, and is reported as such.

terrain_note: No DEM was sampled for this test set. It is reported together with the terrain-free subset of the main holdout so the two are compared on like terrain coverage.
